text:
sanjay: kicking off borealis region bring-up. minimal smoke checklist below — posting here so oncall + infra owners can ack and run. plan is to validate infra, network, gpu-pools, and basic perf gates before handing to platform team for canary traffic.
maria: ack. I'll own GPU pool validation + NVLink checks. ETA 30m.
aj: i'll run network and routing sanity (bgp/peering + calico rules). ping me if any egress weirdness.
kevin: will do node-level bootstraps and kubelet health. also check ssd mount permissions on /var/lib/containerd.
lia: I'll run cost-est estimate from the provisioning layout and flag any oversized SKUs. want to avoid overprovisioning for first week.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: borealis-smoke-1767112468 (cron: @now). will post results as replies.
sanjay: checklist (run in order, mark pass/fail):
1) infra bootstrap
- provisioning API returned success for 12 nodes (n1-gpu-rtx6000)? -> command: `infractl list --region borealis --tag borealis-boot`
- node join count == 12
2) network
- vpc peering ok, firewall rules allow 1024-65535 ephemeral
- control-plane <-> nodes latency p50 < 6ms
- test command: `nettest --targets controlplane,borealis-gw`
3) storage
- containerd rootfs on nvme mounted, iops smoke: `fio --name=smoke --iodepth=16 --rw=read` within expected
4) gpu runtime
- nvidia-smi shows all GPUs present
- nv_peer_mem and rdma modules loaded
- run short GPT inference to confirm model load: `curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/predict -d '{"model":"tiny-test","input":"hi"}'`
5) kube & k8s services
- `kubectl get nodes` Ready condition true for all
- rollout status for infra daemonsets ok
6) perf gates
- p95 inference latency < 120ms on 64 token run
- tail CPU steal < 2%
- gpu utilization 60-80% under synthetic load
7) SLO & error gates
- 5xx error rate < 0.5% over 5m
- pod restart rate < 1 per node during tests
8) graceful fallback
- validate routing policy to redirect 10% of requests to fallback region if capacity low
- test by toggling `routingctl set-fallback borealis->helix 10%`
maria: infractl shows 12 nodes, kube join 12/12, but two nodes show `nvidia-device-plugin` crashloop. investigating logs: `OutOfMemoryError` in plugin container.
kevin: what does `kubectl describe pod` show for one of those? could be an init container failing for device plugin.
maria: paste logs snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z nvidia-device-plugin: failed to probe device: driver not ready
2026-03-18T14:02:12Z nvidia-device-plugin: retrying in 3s
```
aj: networking check ok from control plane to nodes. no packetloss, p50=4ms. but noticed MTU mismatch on borealis-gw (1500 vs 9000) — could explain some RDMA failures.
lia: cost quick scan: default SKUs are high perf. estimate monthly: $21k for 12 nodes using rtx6000 equiv. propose switching 4 nodes to rtx5000 equiv for staging.
sanjay: agree, keep 8 production-grade and 4 staging for canary. liaison with infra procurement later.
maria: fixed device plugin by updating driver symlink on two nodes (`/usr/lib/nvidia`), restarted daemonset, plugin now Running. `nvidia-smi` shows GPUs visible.
ops-bot: borealis-smoke-1767112468: infra bootstrap PASSED; network CHECK minor; gpu runtime FAIL->partial (2/12 nodes previously failing, now fixed); running perf probe.
deploy-bot: canary job started: borealis-canary-1767112468 -> sending 50 rps synthetic to model tiny-test for 5m.
kevin: kube readiness all nodes Ready. daemonsets stable. kube-proxy latencies normal. mounting checks for containerd OK.
aj: MTU mismatch corrected on borealis-gw to 9000, retesting RDMA. small window where fabric flaps were seen.
maria: perf probe results: p95=98ms on 64 tokens, gpu util avg 68%. 5xx rate 0.12% during run.
lia: updated cost spreadsheet, switching 4 nodes downgrades estimate to $16.4k/mo. added note about potential preemptible savings.
sanjay: two remaining tasks before handoff:
- run 1h soak with 20% traffic (canary) and monitor SLOs
- schedule quick readiness review with platform @kevin @maria @aj in 30m
kevin: i'll pull the readiness packet and post a short runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/infra/borealis/bringup
aj: observed one spike in egress error at t+120s -> looks transient, origin: NAT gateway throttle. opened ticket #INF-8243.
maria: soak started. will monitor logs, alerting will notify channel on breaches.
ops-bot: alert rule test: firing test-alert: cpu_high_borealis node:borealis-node-07 -> resolved.
sanjay: great job team. if soak stays green for 1h we hand to platform for canary rollout. leave any follow-ups as thread replies here. :thumbsup:
